daily.headline: More waist-to-head-high surf. Not a lot to get excited about but fun enough for the keen.
daily.observation:
Much the same as yesterday but touch smaller and weaker. Waist to head high surf from the SSW depending on location and exposure to the swell in the water. 

Dawn/early session is seeing a fun enough wave for the west coast beachies and southern swell magnets. Currently we have light ESE winds although there is some surface texture about, before heading to another modest 1.1m low just before lunch. SSE winds to trend from mid morning.

daily.headline: SSW energy begins to fill in. Trade winds still trending. Bukit reefs the pick for the PM session.
daily.observation: Some added SSW energy is expected through the second half of the day boosting size up a notch. Southern exposures should see head/overhead surf into sunset, with some fun waves likely for the Bukit reefs under SSE winds. Earlier in the day we will likely see more waist to head high surf and east winds similar to the previous day or so.

daily.headline: SSW swell smaller again. Options and quality likely limited. Early winds favour the west coast.

2026-11-12.name: Old Man's / Batu Bolong

daily.headline: Growing size from the SSW to see some fun surf along the Bukit through the PM session.
daily.observation: As expected, size has bumped up a notch or two thanks to some increasing energy from the SSW. We currently have a drained out low, leaving us with plenty of exposed reef seen around the island. Size is in the stomach to head/ overhead region depending on location and exposure. NNE winds are currently making for some fun surf along the West Coast, as the Bukit has some surface texture about, as does the east coast. SSE winds will trend from the late morning favouring the Bukit reefs.

daily.headline: SW energy peaks through the AM session under E/ENE winds. SE winds trend through PM
daily.observation: Trailing bump of SW swell to see size peak through the morning with some decent energy behind it to see 2ft OH+ surf for the southern exposures and magnets. Keep in mind the drained-out 0.3 m low tide at dawn that will limit options, but with the incoming tide, expect some fun/good waves through the mid-morning period. SE winds will trend through the PM session, making for a nice afternoon of Bukit reef waves with the dropping tide.

daily.headline: Slowly fading swell from the SW. User friendly, good surf expected.
daily.observation: The latest run of SW swell is expected to lose energy today. Still, for the exposures, size should be in the overhead+ range and quite appealing. Early E/ENE winds will favour the west coast breaks that work with a low tide. A late morning SE wind swing will then make for the best and most appealing conditions seen down along the Bukit peninsula.

daily.headline: Early signs of fresh long period SSW swell later in the day, south swell magnets to grow in size
daily.observation: Worth watching the south swell magnets through the day. These will lift from the initial mid sized, relatively mellow morning surf to a little bit more of an energetic 2ft OH, occasionally bigger in the afternoon. Selective swell angle means less exposed spots will see much less of this wrapping in. Decent potential on the Bukit reefs, with afternoon wind something to watch for the outer corners.
